thread:
Noah Kim: Quick UX question: SLO slider uses ms but users sometimes typed '0.15' (sec) in feedback. Should we accept seconds input in text field or make units explicit? Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/def456/slo-slider
Zoe Lin: We should keep ms everywhere to avoid unit mismatch. Add placeholder 'e.g., 150' and helper 'milliseconds (ms)'.
Evan (PM): Analytics show a small spike in misconfigured SLOs when customers use fractional units. I vote for making units explicit and adding inline validation + helper.
Oliver (Design): I'll change placeholder and helper copy. Also suggest adding a small suffix label on the input 'ms' so even keyboard users see unit.
accessibility-bot: Ensure aria-describedby references the helper and aria-invalid gets set when validation fails. Provide clear error message 'Please enter value in milliseconds'.
Noah Kim: Ok will implement then. Anyone object to short copy: Label: 'Target P95 latency (ms)'; Helper: 'Enter P95 target in milliseconds. Lower = lower latency, higher = higher cost.'
Zoe Lin: thumbs up.
Evan (PM): Merge by EOD if possible; this is a quick win.
